user.title: Seasonal heating schedule
user.description: Adds a page to the sidebar where you divide the year into seasons and give each season weekly programs with time blocks for your thermostat.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

data.admin_only: Only show the panel to administrators

data_description.away_temperature: Used while Away is on, for thermostats that have no away preset. Thermostats with an away preset use that instead.
data_description.admin_only: Non-admin users can view schedules but never change them.

not_loaded.message: The seasonal heating schedule is not set up.

init.title: Thermostat {entity_id} no longer exists
init.description: A schedule exists for {entity_id}, but that entity was removed. Move the schedule to another thermostat, or delete it.

menu_options.reassign: Move the schedule to another thermostat

reassign.title: Move schedule
reassign.description: Choose the thermostat that should get the schedule of {entity_id}.

remove.title: Delete schedule
remove.description: The schedule of {entity_id} will be deleted.

resume_schedule.name: Resume schedule
resume_schedule.description: Applies the current time block again, undoing manual changes made on the thermostat.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the seasons and the programs of a thermostat.

entity_id.name: Thermostat
entity_id.description: The climate entity whose schedule to return.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Creates a schedule or replaces the programs of some seasons. Use the output of Get schedule as an example.

programs.name: Programs
programs.description: Programs keyed by season id. Each program has an id, a name, its weekdays (mon to sun) and its time blocks.
